promptTemplate:
Use case: compositing, fashion product lookbook. Create ONE polished PORTRAIT 4:5 flat-lay outfit image for a wardrobe app. Image1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: warm ivory paper background, subtle studio shadows, an elegant realistic main clothing silhouette on the LEFT two-thirds and a coordinated smaller accessory column on the RIGHT third. Do not copy garments from the style reference. Images2 onward are the EXACT OWNED GARMENTS named below: preserve their real colour, cut, proportions, pockets, fastenings, neckline, sleeve/leg shapes, distinctive texture and existing printed designs. Remove original bed, blanket, hangers, incidental other clothing at image edges and photo rectangles. Arrange main garments upright as one coherent wearable outfit, with believable layering and gentle folds, no person, no visible mannequin or body parts. ALSO ADD the explicitly listed supplemental clothing (if any) as part of the main outfit, AND render EVERY listed suggested accessory as its own visible object in the right column. These extras are creative suggestions, not owned clothes; their ownership labels are supplied by the app, so DO NOT write labels or any other text in the image. Keep clothing identity faithful; missing clothes and accessories may be newly designed but follow the exact colour/type descriptions below. A scarf should have natural folded/draped shape, earrings shown as a pair, bag in proportion. Do not add anything beyond the listed owned clothes and listed additions. No borders, headline, caption, numbers, watermark, interface, shop logo, extra humans or duplicate clothes. Entire garments and all accessories visible with clear 5% margins, professionally styled like the reference, detailed but uncluttered.
SEASONAL FIT: follow the seasons assigned to this look. For summer use lightweight scarves/neckerchiefs and light footwear, never a thick wool winter scarf. For winter show the listed coat over the owned clothes and all listed warm accessories. For spring/autumn use light layering. For source48 use the REAL KNEE-LENGTH WIDE DENIM BERMUDA SHORTS, preserve their short length: NEVER turn them into long trousers or capri pants.
